From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 08:19:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Webcast attendee export and suggested lead attribution

Quick sync on what I pulled — I exported HubSpot event/campaign attributions and cross-referenced with the EventOps CSV. Findings:

- For Acme Bank: three contacts are tagged with campaign = "Q4-webcast-tech". Two records (jen.park@acmebank.com and ops@acmebank.com) show the same person but one is a system alias; the second record (mktg.team@acmebank.com) is a list-address that HubSpot ingested as a contact (likely from a forwarded digest). HubSpot's first-touch attribution set campaign on ingest for the list-address because the list-signup used a UTM tag.
- The two disputed records have lifecycle stage = "Lead" but no engagement beyond the digest click. Only jen.park@acmebank.com has a demo CTA that created an activity.
- The attribution-rule-export.json (attached) shows a campaign-merge rule that favors any UTM match over existing contact properties — this is the root cause for the list-address being credited.

Recommendation:
1) Re-tag the list-address contacts to "internal:acme" and remove campaign = "Q4-webcast-tech" (non-sales influence).
2) Update the attribution merge rule to prefer explicit CTA activity over raw UTM-only ingestion for 30 days retroactive.
3) Run a reconciliation job for the last 6 weeks and produce a delta report so Finance can decide commission impacts.

I can run (1) today. For (2) we should schedule a change window — it will affect historical campaign counts if we backfill.

—Marissa

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Nov 2025 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Webcast attendee export and suggested lead attribution

Good diagnostic, Marissa. A couple of operational notes from my side:

- Commission policy: we only pay for leads/opps that are both (a) externally-sourced and (b) demonstrably engaged (CTA or SDR log). If attribution changes remove the external-sourced flag, Finance will need a signed exception to pay commissions.
- For speed, I approve Marissa's (1) re-tagging of list-addrs to internal and removing campaign tags. Please label the change with ticket ID: MKT-1147 so we have an audit trail.
- For the attribution rule change (2), schedule the change on Monday 12/1 0200-0400 UTC. We'll do a backfill only for Acme and the last 6 weeks to limit scope. Communicate to CS and Revenue Ops ahead of time.

Connor — please confirm you want me to notify Jen at Acme that we're reclassifying two records and that only the organic demo CTA will stand as influenced. I'll also flag commissions as pending until reconciliation completes.

—Lauren
